name: llmslim
description: Long-term memory for MCP clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and others) with no LLM call. Stores user and assistant messages word for word in local SQLite or Postgres, recalls the ones that answer a question within a token budget, and shrinks long text to a budget. The user and agent scope is fixed when the server starts, not chosen by the model.

LLMSLIM_MEMORY_DB.description: SQLite file that holds the memory, or a postgresql:// URL (needs llmslim[postgres]); default ~/.llmslim/memory.db

LLMSLIM_USER_ID.description: Whose memory this server holds (default "default"); fixed when the server starts, not chosen by the model

LLMSLIM_AGENT_ID.description: Optional agent id, so each agent keeps its own memory

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Stores a message word for word and returns its id.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Returns the stored messages that answer a question, whole and under their dates, within a token budget.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: Lists recent messages with their ids, newest first.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Deletes one message by id. It cannot be undone.

tools.name: fit_context
tools.description: Shrinks a long text to a token budget, keeping what answers the query, in order.
